sourceTests.evidence: The same source commit was tested for alpha.2; tests were not rerun for this packaging-only rebuild.

archiveChecks: Both final archives pass SHA-256 sidecar verification and ZIP integrity checks.
Both app bundles pass codesign --verify --deep --strict and have sealed resource manifests.
The ARM64 archive was extracted and launched; the app reached Help & Support.
The Intel x64 app bundle architecture was inspected; native Intel launch was not tested.
The main executable in each archive matches the declared architecture.

limitations: Bundles use ad-hoc signatures only; they have no Developer ID signature or Apple notarization.
Gatekeeper may warn or block launch; no Gatekeeper override is included.
Only macOS archives are refreshed in alpha.3. Windows x64 and Linux x64 remain on alpha.2.
The ARM64 smoke test restored the saved PSAA-Dev workspace and began its normal connection flow; no environment interaction was performed.
No native Intel macOS launch test was performed.
No automatic update channel is enabled by these packages.
This Alpha is not suitable for production Dataverse data or business-critical work.
